text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you are in good spirits today as 
well... My Liege..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
……I-I am utterly ashamed! It being a 
precious day off, I sought the supreme 
sleep――

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I tried working out with some sword 
practice before bed, but it ended up 
having the opposite effect... I'm wide 
awake now...!

Your good intentions seemed to have 
backfired, and Durandal was unable to get 
sufficient rest...
